openings.claim: A manifest-indexed boundary ledger can report supported divergence intervals while exposing timestamp conflicts and missing digests. Replace timestamp ordering with explicitly labelled expected manifest order; compare corresponding boundary digests. A downstream input may witness missing upstream output only when manifest and dictionary establish identical artifact identity; otherwise retain the gap.
openings.discriminator: The rival sorts timestamps and names the first unequal recorded output as divergence. On timestamp inversion and missing transform outputs, the ledger should expose chronology uncertainty and preserve unresolved intervals unless supplied records justify narrowing. Downstream input narrows only with demonstrated artifact identity. This proposed discriminant is not observed improvement.
openings.probe: Use script or spreadsheet for references, equalities, inequalities, gaps and conflicting order evidence. Assign two disjoint three-pair subsets to the two variants. Log every manual inspection; stop at twelve per pair. Budget sixty minutes review and twenty comparison. During final review, randomly remove one transform record from each of two pairs, preserving manifests. Freeze claims, intervals, references and next checks before opening either sealed answer sheet. Compare injected-boundary containment, incorrect definite claims, inspection counts and completion. Record infeasibility if preparation exceeds capacity; the cap alone is not successful testing.
openings.uncertainty: Expected manifest order does not establish execution chronology. Digest equality concerns only recorded artifacts and explains no mismatch. Unresolvable cross-stage identity forbids surrogate output claims. Different subset difficulty prevents clean causal comparison. Defeat includes unsupported definite stages, intervals excluding injected boundaries, or failure within time/inspection limits.

lineage.reason: Retains relation, rival, discriminant, artifact-identity condition, uncertainty, resource limits, disturbance, stopping caveat, defeat conditions and declared preserves fit.

decision: Retain D1 as an untested candidate. For all six pairs, report cited earliest supported divergence or unresolved interval and bounded next check of supplied records. Separate observed mismatches from explanations; absent records never prove nonexecution. Every definite stage claim requires supplied-record citation.
